title: Phase 1 acceptance: the second game's replay spot check (g50t-5849a774)

proxy/tools/replay_spotcheck.py: sessions_from_recon: every successful RESET opens a new pass; passes are separate sessions (recon/<label>, recon/<label>#2, ...). The g50t precheck has aborted and partial passes under one label; folding them stacked two RESETs at position 0.

clean_prefix: truncate at the first step_idx discontinuity. The precheck's short-game-id rows fail the game filter and leave holes; without the rule, a step at step_idx 6 lands at position 3 and misalignment reads as disagreement.
